run_2d_pose_inference: run 2D pose estimation on an input image using a pretrained MMPose model
run_3d_pose_inference: run 3D pose estimation on an input video using a pretrained MMPose model
run_pose_with_detector: run pose estimation with a custom detection model and category IDs
display_model_aliases: display all available MMPose model aliases and their corresponding model names
run_pose_with_visualization: run pose inference and save visualized results with bounding boxes and heatmaps
